crossRefs.note: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
crossRefs.keyword: by preparing their meat in due season

translations.web: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
translations.bsb: The ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;
translations.kjv: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
translations.asv: The ants are a people not strong, Yet they provide their food in the summer;
